policy: Runnable models in the live local Svemir CLI menu are eligible only inside each provider's reviewed model family. Ollama is restricted to reviewed local chat models; remote and embedding-only models are excluded. Antigravity is restricted to the reviewed Gemini family - the two Flash tiers and one Pro tier - and does not mix in Claude or GPT aliases. The Claude Code CLI is reached through the same Svemir bridge menu and is restricted to the sonnet and haiku aliases; opus is not spent on a routine cadence. Claude's own interval is four hours rather than fifty minutes, because one CLI round trip carries its whole environment as input and the subscription window is weekly; it is the route that answers when Antigravity cannot, not the busy one. One attempt per five-minute tick; at least 30 minutes between accepted monologues, at most 72 attempts per UTC day and 24 per route family. Failed models cool down; account quota errors also defer sibling models. Every attempt and complete response is retained. No catch-up bursts. Hourly output remains an availability target.
